about.title: The WoodHub story
paragraphs: Shopping for wooden furniture takes far too much time: customers search everywhere to find a piece they like, then compare prices across dozens of different workshops and suppliers — yet still struggle to picture how the item will actually look in their own room.

On the other side, small workshops and businesses have almost no online channel of their own. They depend almost entirely on nearby walk-in customers, so even with great craftsmanship they find it hard to reach new buyers.

WoodHub was started by Nguyễn Tuấn Toàn (team leader) to solve exactly these two problems: a platform that helps customers find, compare and preview products right in their real space, while opening a digital channel for small workshops. What sets WoodHub apart is AI product advice, AR/3D preview, made-to-order custom design, and a direct link between businesses and production workshops.
about.illustrationQuote: From a workshop in Tan Binh
about.illustrationDesc: to a platform connecting hundreds of workshops with customers nationwide.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: WoodHub ("we") operates the WoodHub website and Android app (vn.woodhub.app) — a wood furniture marketplace for B2C, B2B and custom orders. This policy explains what data we collect, how we use it and your rights over it.

sections.title: 1. Data we collect
items: Account information: name, email, phone number, password (stored hashed, we cannot read it). If you sign in with Google, we receive your name, email and profile picture from Google.
Delivery information: shipping addresses and the map location you pick when adding an address.

Order and payment information: products, quantities, order value, payment status. We do NOT store card numbers or banking passwords — payments are made by VietQR bank transfer in your own banking app.
Business information (B2B customers, suppliers, workshops): company name, tax code, contact details and payout account.
Content you create: images and descriptions uploaded for 3D design, product reviews, messages with suppliers and conversations with the AI assistant.
Usage data: pages viewed, device and browser type, used for statistics and product improvement.

sections.title: 2. How we use it
items: Creating and managing your account, authenticating sign-in (including email OTP codes).
Processing orders, quotes, delivery and payment reconciliation.
Connecting you with the supplier / workshop fulfilling your order.
Product advice via the AI assistant and generating custom 3D models.
Sending order and account notifications; customer support.
Traffic statistics to improve the website and app.

sections.title: 3. Sharing with third parties
sections.body: We do not sell personal data. Data is shared only as needed with:
items: The supplier / workshop handling your order: name, phone number, delivery address and order details.
SePay / VietQR: bank transfer reconciliation.
Google: Google sign-in and Google Analytics (traffic statistics).
Goong Maps: maps and address suggestions.
AI services (including Meshy): processing images/descriptions to generate 3D models and answer advisory questions.
Competent authorities when required by law.

sections.title: 4. Android app permissions
items: Internet, network / Wi-Fi state: to load content, place orders and detect when you are offline.
Camera: when you use AR furniture placement or take a photo to upload. The camera feed is processed on your device and is not sent to our servers unless you choose to upload a photo.
Photos, videos and storage: when you pick images from your device to upload (design references, review photos) or save files (invoices, QR codes).
Microphone: only when you use voice input (where available); audio is not recorded or stored.
Location: when you choose "use my current location" while adding a delivery address. We do not track your location in the background.
Fingerprint / biometrics: only for quick unlock if you enable it; biometric data stays on your device and is never sent to us.
Display over other apps, vibration: for notifications and the floating chat window.
Android asks for each of these permissions when needed (except internet, network and vibration), and you can revoke them at any time in your phone settings.

sections.title: 5. Storage and security
items: Data is transmitted over encrypted HTTPS connections and stored on WoodHub servers.
Passwords are hashed before storage; only authorized team members can access admin data.
Data is kept while your account is active; order records may be kept longer for accounting and tax obligations.

sections.title: 6. Your rights
items: View and edit your personal information and addresses on the Profile page.
Request deletion of your account and personal data by emailing us (see Contact). We process requests within 30 days.
Turn off notifications in Notification settings.

sections.title: 7. Children
sections.body: WoodHub is not intended for people under 16 and does not knowingly collect data from children.

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: When this policy changes, we will update the date at the top of this page. For significant changes, we will notify you on the website or in the app.
